faq.title: Everything to know before you begin.

items.q: What is the difference between Mariable Free and Premium?
items.a: The free space lets you start planning. The €29 Couple offer extends the wedding-day app, AI, storage, exports and Premium resources.
Yes. Mariable Couple costs €29 per wedding, paid once with no subscription.

items.q: What is the difference between Couple and Pro?
items.a: Couple is designed for one wedding. Mariable Pro lets professionals manage unlimited weddings, collaborate with clients and gain visibility with couples.

items.q: Can a couple collaborate with their wedding planner?
items.a: Yes. Wedding information can be centralized and shared so the couple and professional work from the same timeline.

items.q: Can I share the schedule with my vendors?
items.a: Yes. The wedding-day schedule can be shared by link. Each person can view useful information and use the available filters from their phone.

items.q: Can Mariable Pro manage multiple weddings?
items.a: Yes. The €149 annual Pro offer includes unlimited weddings in one professional space.
Mariable is a web app available on computer, tablet and phone, with no mandatory download.

items.q: How do I install Mariable on my phone?
items.a: Mariable works directly in your browser, with no App Store or Google Play download. You can add it to your home screen and open it like an app.

installModal.title: Install Mariable on your phone
installModal.intro: Installation is free and does not require an app store. Follow the instructions for your phone.

steps.title: On iPhone or iPad
steps.body: Open mariable.fr in Safari, tap Share, choose “Add to Home Screen”, then confirm by tapping “Add”.

steps.title: On Android
steps.body: Open mariable.fr in Chrome, open the three-dot menu, then choose “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
